name: GitHub Actions Watch
author: raybarrera
description: Bar widget showing currently running and queued GitHub Actions workflow runs for a GitHub account, backed by a Go helper.

barWidget.description: One bar icon and one panel: how many Actions runs are in progress or queued right now for a GitHub user or org, with repo, workflow, branch, and elapsed time for each.

schema.label: GitHub account
schema.description: User or org login to watch. Leave empty to watch the account gh is authenticated as.

schema.label: GitHub host
schema.description: Optional hostname for GitHub Enterprise. Leave empty for github.com.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: Polls use one conditional request per repo; unchanged repos return 304. Default is five minutes to stay gentle on the GitHub API.

schema.label: Max repos to scan
schema.description: Most recently pushed repos are scanned first. Lower this to reduce calls on the first poll; unchanged polls use conditional requests.

schema.label: Include queued runs
schema.description: Adds one extra API request per repo. Off by default to reduce rate-limit use; manual refresh always includes queued runs.
